title: CppCon 2017: Herb Sutter “Meta: Thoughts on generative C++”
summary: At CppCon 2017 Herb Sutter presents his work on evolving C++ through compile-time code generation, including metaclasses and reflection. The aim is to make the language both more powerful and simpler by letting programmers express intent directly.
why: Praised as the best talk of CppCon 2017 and the key introduction to metaclasses and generative C++.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Herb Sutter's talk about it is by far the best talk I've seen from from CppCon17.
